title: Verify: Boy manifest animations, sizes and generator unit tests
summary: Unit tests for animations/origin copy and boy registration
description: Test generateAssets with and without new fields and the boy entries from ART_SOURCES.

steps.action: Create tests: (1) a two-frame inline ArtSource with animations {idle:{frames:[0,1],frameRate:2,repeat:-1}} and origin {x:0.5,y:1} through generateAssets gives an entry with equal animations and origin; (2) a source without them gives an entry where 'animations' and 'origin' are not in the entry; (3) ART_SOURCES ids contain 'character:boy-sheet' and 'character:boy-portrait' once each; (4) entries from generateAssets(BOY_SOURCES) give sheet dimensions 448x48, frameCount 14, animations idle [0..3], walk [4..9], interact [10..13] with positive frameRate, portrait dimensions 32x32; (5) parseManifest({version:1,assets:entries}).ok is true.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/boyManifest.test.ts
